verdict.rationale: Pipecat's own docs say developers can swap speech services from 200+ integrated providers, usually with one line of code, which supports plugging in multiple providers. However, no evidence names TTS providers specifically or describes a voice library or voice selection. Missing for 10: explicit list of supported TTS providers, documentation of voice selection or a voice library, independent hands-on corroboration of switching TTS voices.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose from a broad voice library or plug in multiple TTS providers to get the voice I want
